QuestInfo.name: Excavation Report
QuestInfo.0: Winston has something that needs to be delivered to Dances with Balrog. Find out what it is.
QuestInfo.1: You received a black pouch that contains seedlings, and a letter on the status of excavations. You are to deliver these items to Dances with Balrog in Perion.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered all the requested items to Dances with Balrog.

0.0: I'm still confused as to how a tree stump becomes haunted in the first place, but these Seedlings should answer a few questions. Now then, I have one more favor to ask of you. Are you agreeable?

yes.0: Kindly deliver this Seedling Pouch and letter to #bDances with Balrog#k. I've explained everything in this letter, so Dances with Balrog should be prepared for the worst. We must each do our part to avoid a haunted stump invasion!

no.0: Oh, no, wait! If you're returning to town, you can do this for me on the way!

1.0: My young Warrior! You look stronger and wiser already. How can I help you?

yes.0: You came to deliver Winston's message, I see. Thank you.

item.0: If you have lost something, you should retrace your steps. Seek answers along your own path. Or, just go back to the person that sent you and get another one.

lost.0: I say, I found the #bSeedling Pouch#k and #bletter#k that I gave you! They were on the ground... Are you certain I can trust you with such sensitive materials?
